RE: WEATHER ADVISORY – HEAVY RAINFALL AND FLOODING RISK ACROSS OYO STATE (20–24 MAY 2026)

The National Emergency Management Agency weather_alert_issued on 2026-05-20 in its weather advisory. Record status: historical. This advisory is issued in collaboration with the Nigerian Meteorological Agency (NiMet) and the Oyo State Emergency Management Agency (SEMA).

**Summary of Forecast**

Widespread thunderstorms are expected across Oyo State from 20 May 2026 through 24 May 2026. The following areas are at elevated risk of flash flooding:

- Ogbomoso North and Ogbomoso South
- Iseyin and surrounding farm settlements
- Ibarapa East and Ibarapa Central
- Oyo East and Oyo West

**Expected Impacts**

1. Accumulated rainfall of 50–80 mm per day in the affected areas.
2. Overflow of rivers and streams, particularly along the Ogun River basin.
3. Waterlogging of low-lying farmlands and access roads.
4. Possible disruption to the movement of agricultural produce on rural roads.

**Recommended Actions for Cooperatives and Farmers**

1. Suspend planting or harvesting activities in low-lying areas during the advisory period.
2. Move harvested produce to elevated, covered storage facilities.
3. Ensure drainage channels around storage facilities are cleared and unobstructed.
4. Do not attempt to cross flooded roads or waterways on foot or by vehicle.
5. Keep livestock away from riverbanks and flood-prone grazing areas.
6. Monitor local radio and SEMA announcements for updates.

**Reporting**

Any flood-related incidents affecting cooperative members or storage facilities should be reported to the Oyo State SEMA Emergency Line: 0800-736-2762, or to the NEMA Zonal Office in Ibadan (Zonal Coordinator, South West Zone) on 0803-555-0147.

The Agency will issue further advisories if the situation changes.

**RE: 2027 AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT GRANT – CALL FOR APPLICATIONS**

The Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security (FMAFS) is pleased to announce the opening of the 2027 Agricultural Cooperative Development Grant cycle. This grant is designed to support registered cooperative societies engaged in value-adding activities, input bulk procurement, and rural infrastructure improvements.

**Grant Objectives**

The grant supports projects that:

- Improve post-harvest storage and processing capacity
- Strengthen cooperative input supply chains
- Enhance climate-resilient farming practices
- Facilitate market access for smallholder members

**Eligibility Criteria**

Applicant cooperatives must:

1. Be duly registered with the Cooperative Societies Department of their State Ministry of Commerce and Industry for at least three years.
2. Have a minimum of 50 registered members.
3. Provide audited financial statements for the past two years.
4. Demonstrate a track record of member benefit distribution.
5. Be in good standing with any previous FMAFS-funded projects.

**Grant Amounts and Matching Requirements**

| Grant Tier | Maximum Amount (₦) | Cooperative Matching Contribution |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 – Infrastructure | 15,000,000 | 20% |
| Tier 2 – Equipment | 10,000,000 | 15% |
| Tier 3 – Capacity Building | 5,000,000 | 10% |

**Application Requirements**

Applications must include:

- Completed application form (FMAFS/AGR/GRT/2027/Form A)
- Project proposal (maximum 15 pages)
- Work plan and budget
- Cooperative registration certificate
- Audited financial statements (2024 and 2025)
- List of executive committee members
- Letter of intent signed by the cooperative secretary

**Application Deadline**

The Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security grant_application_deadline is 2026-11-30 in its announcement. Record status: current. All completed application packages must be submitted to the Department of Agricultural Extension, Room 214, Federal Secretariat Complex, Abuja, no later than 4:00 p.m. on Monday, 30 November 2026. Late submissions will not be considered.

**Submission Format**

Applications may be submitted in hard copy or electronically as a single PDF file. Electronic submissions should be sent to the dedicated grant portal at grants.fmafs.gov.ng. The subject line of the email should read: "2027 COOP GRANT – [Cooperative Name] – [State]".

**Evaluation Process**

Applications will be evaluated by an inter-departmental committee. Shortlisted cooperatives will be contacted for site verification visits between 15 and 31 January 2027. Final award announcements are expected by 28 February 2027.

**Disbursement Schedule**

Successful applicants will receive funds in two tranches:

- 60% upon signing of the grant agreement
- 40% upon submission of a satisfactory progress report and verified project milestone completion

**Additional Information**

Applicants are advised to note the following:

- Only one application per cooperative will be accepted.
- Projects must be completed within 18 months of fund disbursement.
- Cooperative societies that previously received FMAFS grants must have fully complied with all reporting requirements.
- The Ministry reserves the right to verify all information provided.
